company.name: HybrixAI
company.mission: Provide 24/7 AI-powered call assistants and chatbots to automate operations, capture leads, and book appointments for service businesses without human overhead.

core_products.ai_chatbot: Automates conversations 24/7 across websites, WhatsApp, and messaging platforms to qualify leads and answer FAQs in under 1 second.
core_products.ai_call_agents: Human-like 24/7 phone agents answering inquiries, qualifying leads, handling simultaneous calls, and transferring urgent cases to staff.
core_products.appointment_booking: Intelligent automated scheduling, confirmation, rescheduling, and calendar syncing with zero friction.
core_products.lead_generation: Automatically identifies, scores, nurtures, and captures high-value visitor data directly into CRMs.
core_products.social_media_automation: AI-generated content creation, scheduling, and multi-platform posting for consistent brand presence.
core_products.generative_marketing: Creates high-converting ad copies, emails, landing pages, and marketing assets.

industries_served.healthcare: Handles 24/7 bookings, test results inquiries, sends reminders to drop no-shows by 45%, escalates urgent cases.
industries_served.real_estate: Qualifies buyer budgets/property types instantly 24/7, alerts agents immediately regarding hot leads.
industries_served.beauty_salons: Automates bookings when stylists are busy, cuts appointment no-shows by 60% via automated reminders.
industries_served.hospitality_restaurants: Handles reservations during rush hours, answers menu items, manages waitlists.
industries_served.automotive_dealerships: Pre-qualifies auto inventory/pricing inquiries, schedules test drives, routes serious buyers to salespeople.
industries_served.legal_law_firms: 24/7 new client intake, collects initial case data, screens practice areas, schedules consultations.

process_and_delivery.step_01_discovery: 30-min discovery call to understand workflows, integrations, and ideal response structures.
process_and_delivery.step_02_training: Configuration of custom voice, business rules, FAQ inputs, CRM/calendar mapping.
process_and_delivery.step_03_deployment: Goes live in 48 hours with full dashboard analytics, real-time tracking, and human override capabilities.

security_and_integrations.security: Enterprise-grade SOC 2 compliant infrastructure, full end-to-end data encryption.
security_and_integrations.uptime_sla: 99.9% availability backed by redundant cloud infrastructure.

value_proposition.offers: Free 30-Minute customized live demo, custom industry layout walkthrough, and tailored ROI calculations.
